name: AURAS Pay
author: Auras Pay

sections.description:
AURAS Pay enables any WordPress website to accept cryptocurrency payments – no WooCommerce or e-commerce plugin required! Perfect for donations, services, digital products, memberships, or any payment scenario.

Built on the powerful AURAS Pay platform, this plugin provides a secure, fast, and user-friendly way to accept crypto payments from customers worldwide using simple shortcodes.

No WooCommerce? No Problem!

Unlike other crypto payment solutions, AURAS Pay works on ANY WordPress site. Simply add a shortcode to any page or post and start accepting payments immediately.

Supported Cryptocurrencies

  • Solana (SOL) – Fast and low-cost transactions
  • USD Coin (USDC) – Stablecoin pegged to USD
  • Bitcoin (BTC) – The original cryptocurrency
  • Ethereum (ETH) – Smart contract platform

Key Features

  • No WooCommerce Required – Works on any WordPress site
  • Simple Shortcodes – Add payment buttons and forms anywhere
  • Multi-Cryptocurrency Support – Accept SOL, USDC, BTC, and ETH
  • QR Code Payments – Customers can scan and pay with mobile wallets
  • Real-time Verification – Automatic payment detection and verification
  • Donation Forms – Perfect for accepting donations with preset amounts
  • Custom Payment Forms – Flexible forms with custom fields
  • Webhook Notifications – Instant payment status updates
  • Automatic Currency Conversion – Convert from any fiat currency to crypto
  • Non-Custodial – You maintain full control of your funds
  • Detailed Logging – Debug mode for troubleshooting
  • Mobile Optimized – Perfect payment experience on all devices
  • Secure – Industry-standard security practices

Use Cases

  • Donations – Accept crypto donations for your cause or content
  • Services – Charge for consulting, freelance work, or services
  • Digital Products – Sell ebooks, courses, or downloadable content
  • Memberships – Accept crypto for membership fees
  • Tips – Let visitors tip you in cryptocurrency
  • Invoices – Create payment links for clients
  • Events – Sell tickets or registrations

Shortcodes

Payment Button:
[auras_pay_button amount=”10″ currency=”USD” label=”Pay Now”]

Payment Form:
[auras_pay_form title=”Make a Payment” currency=”USD” show_amount=”yes”]

Donation Form:
[auras_pay_donate title=”Support Us” amounts=”10,25,50,100″]

Payment Status:
[auras_pay_status]

How It Works

  1. Add a payment shortcode to any page or post
  2. Customer clicks the payment button or fills out the form
  3. Customer is redirected to the checkout page with QR code
  4. Customer scans QR code or clicks to open their wallet
  5. Customer confirms payment in their wallet app
  6. Payment is automatically verified and confirmed

Why Choose AURAS Pay?

  • No WooCommerce Dependency – Works on any WordPress site
  • Fast Transactions – Payments confirmed in seconds
  • No Transaction Fees – Only blockchain gas fees apply
  • Global Reach – Accept payments from anywhere in the world
  • No Chargebacks – Cryptocurrency transactions are final
  • Privacy Focused – No personal information required from customers
  • 24/7 Availability – Blockchain never sleeps

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • AURAS Pay account and API key (Sign up here)
  • SSL certificate (recommended for production)

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Sign up for an AURAS Pay account at auraspay.com
  3. Get your API key from the AURAS Pay dashboard
  4. Go to AURAS Pay > Settings in your WordPress admin
  5. Enter your API key and configure settings
  6. Add shortcodes to your pages and start accepting crypto!

Privacy Policy

AURAS Pay does not collect or store personal information from your visitors beyond what is necessary for payment processing (email if provided). All payment processing is handled securely. Please review the AURAS Pay Privacy Policy for more information.

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services to provide its functionality:

REQUIRED SERVICE:

  • AURAS Pay API (https://auraspay.com/api) – This is the core payment processing service. The plugin sends payment creation requests and receives payment status updates. An API key from AURAS Pay is required for the plugin to function. Data transmitted includes: payment amounts, cryptocurrency addresses, and optional customer email addresses. Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

OPTIONAL SERVICES (Automatic):

  • CoinGecko API (https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/) – Used to fetch real-time cryptocurrency prices for converting fiat currency amounts to crypto amounts. No API key required. No personal data is transmitted. This service is called automatically when creating payments. Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

  • ExchangeRate API (https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/) – Used to convert between different fiat currencies (e.g., EUR to USD) before crypto conversion. No API key required. No personal data is transmitted. This service is called automatically when the payment currency differs from USD. Terms of Service

All external API calls are made server-side. No data is sent to these services from the visitor’s browser.

Credits

  • Developed by the AURAS Pay Team
  • Cryptocurrency price data by CoinGecko

Support

For support, please visit:
* Documentation: https://auraspay.com/docs
* Support Forum: https://auraspay.com/support
* Email: support@auraspay.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AURAS Pay”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate Plugin”

Configuration

  1. Go to AURAS Pay > Settings
  2. Enter your API Key (get it from AURAS Pay Dashboard)
  3. Configure your preferred settings:
    • Default cryptocurrency
    • Payment timeout
    • Success/Cancel redirect pages
    • Currency conversion source
  4. Copy the Webhook URL and add it to your AURAS Pay dashboard
  5. Save changes
  6. Add shortcodes to your pages!
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No! AURAS Pay is designed to work on any WordPress site without WooCommerce or any other e-commerce plugin.

Do I need a cryptocurrency wallet?

Yes, you need a cryptocurrency wallet to receive payments. You can use any wallet that supports the cryptocurrencies you want to accept (Phantom for Solana, MetaMask for Ethereum, etc.).

How do I get an API key?

Sign up for a free account at auraspay.com, complete the verification process, and generate your API key from the dashboard.

Are there any transaction fees?

AURAS Pay does not charge transaction fees. Only standard blockchain network fees (gas fees) apply. You only pay for your API subscription plan.

How do I add a payment form?

Simply add the shortcode [auras_pay_form] to any page or post. You can customize it with attributes like amount, currency, title, etc.

Can I accept donations?

Yes! Use the [auras_pay_donate] shortcode to create a donation form with preset amounts.

How long does it take to receive payments?

Payments are typically confirmed within seconds to a few minutes, depending on the blockchain network. Solana is usually the fastest (1-2 seconds).

Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies?

Yes! Customers can choose from SOL, USDC, BTC, or ETH.

What happens if a payment fails or expires?

The customer can try again or choose a different payment method. Failed payments do not charge the customer.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes, the plugin follows WordPress security best practices. All API communications are encrypted, and webhook signatures are verified.
